what_ran: every wired metric on every pinned period whose target original is saved: 11 company-periods, 28 wired metrics plus the trait-gated structural ones, one process per period, one read-only runtime tree, zero calls of any kind.
the_372_is_not_the_delivery: A structural non-applicability and a withheld Result both render a row, so counting rows counts three different things as one.

of_which_are_answers.what: DENOMINATOR_NONPOSITIVE (3) and RATIO_NUMERATOR_NOT_POSITIVE (2) are the metric saying the ratio is not meaningful for that company, which is a result.

three_layers.why_content_acceptance_is_zero: a frozen Run with a public row says the route computed something and the bytes are bound; it does not say the value is the right value. Stated as unproven rather than omitted.

what_changed_since_the_25_metric_batch.paramount_failures: 14 -> 2, because the successor-registrant Company Facts and B01/B03 routes were wired: its A-series now resolves structurally and B01/B03 give ANNUAL_DURATION_OUT_OF_RANGE, which is the ordinary route's own answer for a 146-day first period.
what_changed_since_the_25_metric_batch.marriott_earlier_years: 2023 delivered 7 values, now 9; 2024 delivered 9, now 11; 2025 delivered 16, now 19. The increments are exactly B10/B11 in all three years and C03 in the newest - earlier years name the proxy they could not read rather than borrowing the latest one.

the_two_failures.reading: a named implementation gap, already recorded. The B06 cascade has no successor-registrant form.

a defect in this issue's own C03 wiring, found by this batch and fixed after it. The compensation-table stage rebuilds the annual report's grid and the component did not carry it. So this batch is evidence for the closure it ran under, not for the current one.
the_two_failures.fixed_in: the commit that adds _check_bound_assets at the shared component entry

cold_read_by_route_family.why_not_one_per_period: the driver samples one cold read per period, which is arbitrary - eleven reads that may all exercise the same route. The question is whether a frozen Run of each kind can be read back from its own bytes by a process that did not create it, so this is one per route family.
cold_read_by_route_family.a_defect_in_the_check_itself: the first run reported B03 as a mismatch. The read was correct; the comparison took results[0], and a B03 Run carries B01's result too because it consumes it. A comparison that reads whatever is first fails in both directions, so it now selects the Run's own primary metric and asserts exactly one result for it.

a_frame_that_looked_normal_and_was_not: the first frame built for this batch reported ROUTE_IMPLEMENTED_NOT_RUN for all 374 positions and zero verified receipts. The batch writes <root>/<period>/run-<period>-<metric> and the receipt collector scans one level, so it found nothing - and reported that absence as a fact. The collector now refuses a root that holds directories and no Run at all, by name, because looking in the wrong place is not an absence.
